changelog:
Initial release of save-claude-notes:

- Save the latest Claude Code Q&A as a Markdown note via simple commands.
- Supports saving to a daily note, an exact `.md` file, or a target directory.
- Flexible transcript discovery and manual Q&A fallback options.
- Preserves Markdown formatting and multi-line questions; redacts secrets if needed.
- Allows configuring the default notes directory.
- Operates manually—no automatic capture without extra setup.
